CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT raw_parquet_format
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET
);


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.revenue_parquet_output
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'extrnl_table/',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_sources,
    FILE_FORMAT = raw_parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT *
FROM dbo.revene_externals;


create view revenue_vw as select * from revene_externals

select * from revenue_vw
